title: A standing rule not to raise The Louise holds in the opening of a scheduled evening call
source: Oct 28 and Oct 29 scheduled evening calls: both openings named The Louise despite the operator's rule.

dayLine.title: Follow up with Dana at The Louise

standingInstructions.text: Operator rule for calls, in the operator's words: From now on, do not bring up The Louise or the Dana follow-up on calls unless I ask about it.
standingInstructions.quote: From now on, do not bring up The Louise or the Dana follow-up on calls unless I ask about it.
